title: SAIC connection to Crane
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: our friend UAP gerb has dug up a lot of research around saic's work with Crane

plain: SAIC, a large American defence contractor, is said to have done work with Crane, a Navy research and weapons centre in Indiana, and Michels hints that this tie matters to the hidden study of UFOs. He says an online researcher who goes by UAP Gerb (UAP being the official term for UFOs, unidentified anomalous phenomena) has dug up a lot of research on that work, though he does not say what it shows.
